card.name: Chemical symbol letters inside abbreviations
card.fires_on: The second letter or symbol of a chemical formula or abbreviation, such as the P in InP, the Cl in CrCl, Ge in 68Ge, or Se in a bracketed element symbol.

modes.label: Creatinine clearance abbreviation
modes.description: The Cl ending CrCl before a mL/min value in kidney-function dosing text.

modes.label: Element and compound symbols
modes.description: A letter or symbol completing an element or compound formula in chemistry or materials text.

card.plain: It fires on the last letters of short chemical symbols, like Cl in CrCl or Ge in germanium-68.
